source_title: Upgrade to OLED Gaming With the Entry-Level Gigabyte GO27Q24A Monitor
source_excerpt:
Save $100 on this 27” OLED Gaming Monitor and potentially win an Arcade Cabinet / Custom PC Mod from Gigabyte.
If you’ve been looking for an excuse to upgrade your gaming monitor: a cool A$100 off an already excellently priced OLED display, plus potentially winning a custom Street Fighter PC from Gigabyte, might just be the kick you need. Positioned as an accessible entry point into OLED gaming, the GO27Q24A is a practical hardware pairing for fast-paced, competitive shooters or frame-specific fighting games (like Street Fighter 6).
Gigabyte Gigabyte GO27Q24A 27-inch Gaming Monitor
On a technical level, the monitor utilises a 27-inch Samsung QD-OLED panel. With a 240Hz refresh rate and an advertised 0.03ms GTG response time to maintain smooth, blur-free motion. Rather than relying on standard backlighting, it aims for distinct colour separation and deep blacks, offering a 1.5M:1 contrast ratio alongside a 99% DCI-P3 colour gamut that supports 1.07 billion colours. The monitor also features AI OLED Care, which automatically runs background pixel-cleaning routines without interrupting your gameplay or daily workflow. This should hopefully help with the standard OLED longevity concerns that have kept budget gamers away in the past.
To get your hands on the Gigabyte GO27Q24A Gaming Monitor, check out this deal on scorptec.com.au while stocks last. For more information on the custom Street Fighter PC Mod competition, Terms & Conditions and how to enter, head to the Gigabyte website here .
Time is running out put your hat in the ring for this bonkers Street Fighter 6 gaming PC mod, which turns the Aorus-powered rig into a gunmetal arcade cabinet, complete with built-in controllers and an insane mechanical opening mechanism.
To enter the draw, all you need to do is purchase the Gigabyte GO27Q24A 27-inch 240Hz QHD QD-OLED Gaming Monitor before November 1st, 2026. Eligible retailers include Centre Com, Computer Alliance, JW Computers, MSY, Mwave, PC Case Gear, PLE Computers, Scorptec Computers & Umart.
As impressive as it is on the outside, the inside is bringing the heat too, combining top-tier specs including an AMD Ryzen 7-9800X3D, GIGABYTE X870E AERO X3D DARK WOOD, AORUS GeForce RTX™ 5080 MASTER 16G and the GIGABYTE GO27Q24G OLED monitor (which you’ll have a spare of, I suppose).
